purpose: Teach: 装丁/通信員/前倒し/相殺/概説/差し引い/値下がり/後ろ向き

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、規則書の装丁を新調されたんですね
lines.en: I see the police department updated the binding on their regulation handbook.
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly impressed. Steady voice, conversational pace. Acknowledging attention to detail without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地方通信員ともご連携されてますね
lines.en: And you're coordinating with local correspondents too, I notice.
lines.style: Curious, genuinely interested. Gentle tone—drawing out information, not interrogating. Leans slightly forward in the rhythm of speech.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、巡回スケジュールの前倒しもなさいますね
lines.en: You're moving up your patrol schedules ahead of time as well.
lines.style: Observational, noting something proactive. Even tone, steady pace. Recognition mixed with mild surprise at the thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪と善行の相殺はないとご指導頂きました
lines.en: You taught us that crime and good deeds don't offset each other.
lines.style: Thoughtful, turning inward slightly. Slower pace on the key phrase. Respectful—citing a lesson learned, not lecturing back.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域防犯事業の概説を市民にされてますね
lines.en: You're giving community crime prevention overviews to residents too.
lines.style: Noticing pattern. Warm appreciation. Steady, conversational rhythm. The voice of someone recognizing consistent effort across multiple fronts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、賠償金から見舞金を差し引いた金額をお伝え下さいました
lines.en: Thank you for explaining how compensation and condolence payments are calculated.
lines.style: Genuinely grateful, slightly formal in register. Clear articulation. Sincere without being effusive. Weight on the gratitude.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不動産値下がり詐欺を捜査されてますね
lines.en: You're investigating that real estate fraud scheme, the one about falling property values.
lines.style: Admiring, slightly understated. Steady confidence in the voice. Recognition of serious work being done without fanfare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、後ろ向きな噂を防ぐ広報、ありがたいです
lines.en: And your public communications work preventing negative rumors—that means a lot.
lines.style: Sincere closing. Warm, genuine. Slight softening at the end. The voice of someone who has felt the weight of rumor and knows what prevents it.
